card.title: A Valuable Safeguard
card.instruction: Treat every delay, restriction, and extra step as evidence that the system is becoming safer and more thorough.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: They've added a fourth inspection to our climbing wall. Wonderful.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: A whole month without an uninspected climb.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then the safest season we've ever offered.

mechanism: A treats inspection delays and lost operating time as evidence of improved safety rather than failure to open.
confusable: Unlike cheerful acceptance of bad news, A must identify the added safeguard as the specific benefit.
comparison: No climbing becomes perfect safety, while the school trip scene adds layers of checking.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
